name: Carlos Mendez
personal_statement: I have served two tours aboard aircraft carriers, flown combat missions over three continents, and spent 186 days on the International Space Station during Expedition 64. Space is not new to me — but what I want to do next is. I am applying for the deep-space programme because I believe the skills I built in the most demanding environments on Earth and in low Earth orbit have prepared me to go further. I am ready.
psychological_profile: Exceptional operational track record. Prior mission performance scored in the 97th percentile for crew adaptability and technical execution. Strong leadership presence. A natural anchor for crew cohesion on long-duration missions. Evaluation performed by Commander Lisa Trent (l.trent@ieahq.int, +1-281-555-0199), who is available for a follow-up briefing if the panel wants it. High-confidence selection.
